The '''Commission of Operations''' was the governing body of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Based out of the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Central Office]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]], the Commission would transmit assignments to the [[Sector Officer]] in charge of the relevant operational branch. Operations conducted between branches in the same [[Sector/Legends|sector]] or cross-sector operation were coordinated by the Commission of Operations.<ref name="ISB" />
